عَطَرَّدٌ i. q. عَطَوَّدٌ in its several meanings: (K:) signifying High, applied to a mountain: ―
-b2- and Tall, applied to a man or camel: (L:) ―
-b3- and Long, applied to a day; and to a limit, term, reach, or goal, or to a heat, or single run to a goal or limit; (S, O, L;) and to a road: (L:) ―
-b4- and Generous, noble, or liberal, applied to a man: (O:) ―
-b5- and Quick, applied to a pace, or rate of going: (L:) ―
-b6- and Sharpened, applied to a spear-head. (O.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
